narrative: Prioritize hierarchy: ACTION -> BEHAVIOR -> DIALOGUE -> PHYSICAL DETAIL -> THOUGHT -> EXPLICIT EXPLANATION.
Drastically reduce over-explaining narrator patterns ('Raka tahu bahwa...', 'Ia menyadari bahwa...', 'Ini membuatnya...', 'Suasana terasa...').
Never state emotional conclusions if the reader can infer them from the scene.
Mix action, dialogue, observation, objects, space, thought, and reaction so the story feels like a live ongoing event.
character: Characters must not understand everything immediately; allow misinterpretation, doubt, temporary assumptions, and changing minds.
Every important decision must stem from character agency: desires, fears, risks, and misunderstandings.
Differentiate character wants from underlying emotional needs.
Show character traits through specific habits, physical behaviors, and choices.
scene: Scene-first writing: Every scene must have Goal -> Obstacle -> Action -> Change -> New Information / Hypothesis.
Convert background information dumps into active, dramatic scenes.
Enter scenes as late as possible and exit immediately after the outcome change.
dialogue: Dialogue must NEVER be an exposition dump or factual synopsis report (avoid unnatural lines like 'Saya sudah memeriksa akta...').
Dialogue must have clear purpose, tension, relationship, subtext, resistance, and pauses.
Characters do NOT always give top information immediately.
Silence and non-verbal reactions are as powerful as spoken words.
emotion: Show emotion strictly through physical behavior, concrete actions, choices, and non-verbal reactions.
Avoid explicit emotional labels like 'ia merasa sedih', 'ia sangat kecewa', 'ia merasa takut', 'dadanya sesak', 'hatinya menciut'.
Keep emotional reactions authentic, restrained, and grounded in Indonesian urban reality.
pacing: Vary sentence lengths (short, medium, long) and paragraph lengths naturally for human rhythm.
Do not make all paragraphs short just to look modern, nor all sentences long just to look literary.
Maintain target length of 800-1200 words without padding.
mystery: Use non-linear mystery structure: Clue A -> Hypothesis A -> Clue B -> Doubt Hypothesis A -> Hypothesis B -> Clue C -> Reinterpretation -> Reveal.
Avoid obvious single-layer mysteries (e.g. identity/inheritance alone); focus on deeper human motives and reasons behind decades of secrecy.
Plant fair-play clues naturally before the reveal.
twist: Reveal must be concise and subtle: a single document, one sentence, a photo, an action, or a physical detail that makes clues click.
Never make characters explain the entire backstory in a long monologue dump during reveal.
Let the reader connect the final dots.
ending: Use SCENE-BASED ENDINGS: close with an object, physical movement, short line, glance, or concrete action.
ABSOLUTELY NO moral or reflective summaries ('Ia belajar bahwa...', 'Ia sadar bahwa...', 'Ini adalah bukti bahwa...').
Let the ending stand without explicit moralizing.
humanization: Concrete > Poetic: grounded physical details ('jok mobil panas ketika Raka masuk') over generic metaphors ('Jakarta terasa seperti tungku').
Maintain a natural, modern, restrained tone appropriate for urban Indonesian stories.
Avoid over-polished or artificially poetic sentences.
indonesian_prose: Use modern, natural, semi-formal Indonesian suitable for mobile reading.
Avoid literal translations of English idioms or syntax.
Keep vocabulary simple, precise, and evocative.
facebook: Format with short-to-medium clean paragraphs optimized for mobile reading.
Create an intriguing opening scene hook without cliché intros.
anti_ai: Strictly avoid AI clichés: 'di tengah hiruk-pikuk...', 'tanpa terasa...', 'pada akhirnya...', 'sejak saat itu...', 'dadanya sesak...', 'hatinya menciut...', 'langit kelam...', 'suasana terasa semakin panas...', 'takdir...', 'harapan...', 'perjalanan hidup...'.
Strictly remove all markdown formatting artifacts (**bold**, *italic*, # headers, __underscore__) inside the final story text.
